title: What 'Borrowing' Actually Means in Subtraction
description: A column-by-column breakdown of what borrowing from the next column really represents when subtracting.
narration_lines: What does borrowing actually mean in subtraction?
Let's subtract 17 from 42, column by column.
Start on the right: 2 minus 7 doesn't work, so borrow 10 from the tens, making it 12 minus 7, which is 5. Then the tens: 3 minus 1 is 2.

params.footnote: borrow from the left when the top digit is too small
